pattern.crimePattern: an event promoter pushes the photographer who can prove she padlocked a fire exit before a crush off a rooftop service terrace; her head bouncer deletes the footage and says the victim was drunk
pattern.notes: Fictional promoter, venue and March incident (fourteen injured, nobody died). ACCOMPLICE against a crowded field of liars; ABSENCE of alcohol and of climbing scrapes against the staff's story.

ob.text: A woman falls from the eighth-floor rooftop bar of a Westlands building during an event: Tracy Odhiambo (29), event photographer. Staff tell police she was drunk and climbed the railing for a photo.

facts.text: Tracy Odhiambo fell from the eighth-floor rooftop of Anga in Westlands just before half past midnight; staff say she was drunk and climbed the railing for a photo.
Fall injuries. Her camera body smashed beside her, the memory-card slot empty.
Her assistant: "She never shoots without two cards, one in the camera, one in her pocket." Neither is on her, on the street or on the terrace.
The service terrace is closed to guests: kegs, a gas store, a waist-high railing.
Ezekiel's first statement: Tracy was very drunk; he saw her climb the railing to get a skyline photo.
Tracy's phone, 00:25, to a journalist: "Meeting Mukami now on the service terrace. She wants to 'talk'. Monday still on."
Tracy's March photos: a padlocked fire exit below a packed staircase, and Mukami's WhatsApp: "Padlock the fire exit, people are sneaking in free." Fourteen people were hurt in the crush.
Pendo: Tracy went through the staff door at about 00:24, Mukami a minute later; Mukami came back alone, white, straight to Ezekiel. Earlier Tracy argued with her ex, Morris, and a guest about photos.
Bar camera: Tracy through the staff door 00:24; Mukami 00:25; Mukami back alone at 00:31, to Ezekiel at 00:33; Ezekiel into the security office at 00:46.
Bar camera: Ezekiel at the rooftop door 00:20–00:33.
Bar camera: Duncan behind the bar all through the half hour.
Bar camera: Wesley at the bar 00:10–00:50, arguing with a friend, never near the staff door.
The bar, lift and terrace cameras all record continuously to the security PC; the bar and lift files are complete.
Security PC log: "Delete — clip 00:20–00:55 — user: HEAD_SEC — 00:48". HEAD_SEC is the head bouncer's account.
Door clickers: 412 guests against a licensed capacity of 300.
Records: at 01:15 Mukami sent Ezekiel KSh 60,000, "balance + bonus".
In Mukami's clutch bag: Tracy's memory card.
The card's last frame, 00:26: a blurred close shot of Mukami's face on the terrace, her hand raised.
Lift camera and taxi: Morris left at 23:52 and was in a taxi by midnight.
Fingerprints taken from Mukami in detention.
Post-mortem: fall injuries; bruising on the upper chest from two hands; none of the palm or inner-arm scrapes a climber gets from a railing; blood alcohol zero.
Post-mortem: death 00:26–00:28 (the fall was seen from the street).
Lab: fibres on the railing's top bar are from the back of Tracy's jacket, not the front or sleeves. She went over backwards.
Lab: Tracy's and Mukami's prints on the memory card.
Missing: there's no alcohol in her blood and no railing scrapes on her hands.
Missing: there's no memory card in her camera.
Missing: the terrace footage from 00:20 to 00:55 is gone.
Missing: Morris isn't on any camera after 23:52.
Missing: there are no other guests on the terrace.

reconstruction.text: In March, at a Skyline Socials concert, a crush on an overcrowded staircase injures fourteen people. The fire exit is padlocked on Mukami's orders. Tracy, crowd-safety officer that night, photographs the padlock and keeps the order.

This week Tracy tells Mukami she will hand her photos to the inquiry and a journalist on Monday. On Saturday she works Mukami's rooftop event as booked. At 00:25 she texts the journalist: "Meeting Mukami now on the service terrace."
On the terrace Mukami asks for the memory card. Tracy refuses. Mukami pushes her backwards over the waist-high railing. She pulls the card from the fallen camera and drops the camera over too.

At 00:33 she tells Ezekiel: "Tracy fell. She was drunk. The terrace camera can't show me there." At 00:48 he deletes 00:20–00:55 and tells the police she climbed for a photo. At 01:15 Mukami sends him KSh 60,000.

clockPlan.note: Two stamps: records on Mukami and Ezekiel, and a warrant on Mukami's flat. The railing fibres (12 h) go first thing; detain Mukami after the search, and the card prints (6 h) come back inside 24 h.
